title: Adopt the shared wiki contract: repo-local surfaces, retrieval, and dispatch readiness
summary: Tracker for the IN-0001 adoption work. Root AGENTS.md may not exist yet in a freshly bootstrapped repo, so the orchestrator must dispatch the mandatory worker-owned implementation slice WK-0001#SLICE-001 (write_scope ["AGENTS.md"]) to populate or adapt it; an empty AGENTS.md does not satisfy the slice. That implementation slice completes only after its own mandatory findings-only review; retiring the obsolete adoption-verification review unit removed a separate readiness unit, never the implementation slice's own review lifecycle. The coordinator runs wiki adoption verify as read-only verification, not as a WK-0001 review unit. Bootstrap seeds this work and agent-launch.toml copy/init-config remains a launcher prerequisite.
scope: Bring the consuming repo up to the shared wiki/agent contract by dispatching the mandatory worker-owned implementation slice WK-0001#SLICE-001 (write_scope ["AGENTS.md"]) to populate or adapt canonical root AGENTS.md. The orchestrator must not write root `AGENTS.md` directly (orchestrator write scope does not include the repo root) and must not skip authoring it, and an empty AGENTS.md does not satisfy the work. WK-0001#SLICE-001 remains subject to mandatory findings-only review after implementation, and that review is required before the slice is treated as done. The coordinator runs npx wiki adoption verify --dir "$PWD" --json as read-only verification of wiki-retrieval, work-records, graph-impact, generate-lint, and dispatch-preflight; this is coordinator-owned read-only verification, not a WK-0001 review unit, and it never substitutes for the implementation slice's mandatory review. The worker derives repo-specific guidance from wiki/templates/AGENTS.md.boilerplate.md and removes unsupported claims. Dispatch implementation only through scoped `WK-*` slices; proceed once required checks pass. The Claude @AGENTS.md bridge remains setup context and is not an independent policy source.
out_of_scope: Do not modify the shared agent-chassis packages, do not edit global MCP client config, do not have the orchestrator write root AGENTS.md directly (dispatch the seeded worker-owned slice `WK-0001#SLICE-001` with write_scope ["AGENTS.md"] via the structured MCP dispatch route instead), do not launch the seeded orchestrator while adoption verify reports missing or invalid launcher config (a missing root AGENTS.md alone is advisory and does not block), do not assign a worker to edit or recreate the bootstrap-generated wiki/.wiki-mcp.json (bootstrap owns it as gitignored local metadata), do not assign a worker to author docs/adoption.md from scratch (bootstrap seeds it from a package template; only optional repo-specific customization remains), do not assign a worker to author agent-launch.toml (package/bootstrap first-run guidance supplies the operator copy/init-config step), and note that bootstrap seeding alone does not make the repo agent-operable.

criteria: Root AGENTS.md may not exist yet in a freshly bootstrapped repo.
The coordinator runs wiki adoption verify as read-only verification and records a specific structured blocker per non-pass check.

Root AGENTS.md is authored/adapted as the primary adoption deliverable via the seeded worker-owned implementation slice `WK-0001#SLICE-001` (write_scope ["AGENTS.md"]), dispatched through the structured MCP dispatch route (never written directly by the orchestrator); the result is repo-adapted rather than a bootstrap-generated placeholder. It may be absent immediately after bootstrap, and a transiently-missing root AGENTS.md does not by itself flip the adoption-verify verdict to blocked, but authoring it remains required adoption work, not optional. The orchestrator must not skip authoring it.

`WK-0001#SLICE-001` remains mandatory worker-owned implementation work that receives a mandatory findings-only review after implementation; that review is required before the slice is treated as done and is never satisfied by the coordinator-owned read-only adoption verification.

The seed tells the agent/operator to run `npx agent-chassis setup`, review/adapt `wiki/templates/AGENTS.md.boilerplate.md` into root `AGENTS.md`, rerun `npx wiki adoption verify --dir "$PWD" --json`, and proceed only after required checks pass.

agent-launch.toml exists as operator-supplied first-run launcher config with explicit model defaults for orchestrator, worker, reviewer, and redteam; the coordinator-owned read-only verification confirms the bootstrap-seeded docs/adoption.md and bootstrap-generated wiki/.wiki-mcp.json (docs/adoption.md present and valid; wiki/.wiki-mcp.json schema wiki-mcp-workspace.v1, a resolved current.root, and a repo-derived current.alias), not authored or edited by bootstrap.
The coordinator runs `npx -p @agent-chassis/wiki-cli wiki adoption verify --dir "$PWD" --json` as read-only verification; the repo is not claimed agent-operable unless the verdict is ready.
The Claude @AGENTS.md bridge is setup context only and CLAUDE.md is not an independent policy source.
The boilerplate is a helper template, not current-session operating authority; the orchestrator write scope does not include the repo root.

slices.title: Populate or adapt repo-local AGENTS.md
slices.summary: Populate or adapt the consuming repo's root AGENTS.md by deriving the seeded boilerplate helper into repo-specific operating guidance; an empty AGENTS.md does not satisfy this slice. This is the primary adoption deliverable; the orchestrator dispatches this worker slice through the structured MCP dispatch route and never writes the repo root directly. Like every implementation slice, it receives a mandatory findings-only review after implementation.
slices.scope: Populate or adapt root `AGENTS.md` by deriving it from `wiki/templates/AGENTS.md.boilerplate.md`: replace the `[repo-name]` placeholder, adapt each section to this repo's real structured tools, retrieval surfaces, and canonical layers, and remove or qualify any boilerplate section describing a tool, MCP capability, or canonical layer this repo has not adopted. The authored file must be repo-specific operating authority, not a blind copy of the helper, and an empty `AGENTS.md` does not satisfy this slice. The write happens only within this worker slice's write_scope (`AGENTS.md`); the orchestrator must not write the repo root directly. This slice is closed only after its mandatory findings-only review; the coordinator-owned read-only adoption verification is separate work and never stands in for that review.
slices.out_of_scope: Do not copy the boilerplate verbatim, do not leave the `[repo-name]` placeholder or any other bracketed placeholder, do not claim unsupported tools/MCP/code-index capabilities or canonical layers, and do not edit shared agent-chassis package source or any file outside `AGENTS.md`.

criteria: Root `AGENTS.md` exists at the repo root, derived from `wiki/templates/AGENTS.md.boilerplate.md` and adapted to this repo rather than copied verbatim.
No `[repo-name]` placeholder or any other bracketed placeholder remains in the authored `AGENTS.md`.

Unsupported tool, MCP, and canonical-layer claims carried by the boilerplate are removed or qualified, so every structured tool, MCP capability, and canonical layer named in `AGENTS.md` is actually supported by this repo.
`AGENTS.md` reads as repo-specific operating authority, not a blind copy of the helper template.

The delivered `AGENTS.md` receives a mandatory findings-only review before this slice is treated as done; that review is required for this implementation slice and is never satisfied by the coordinator-owned read-only adoption verification.
